content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible with a [product_name] to differentiate between a short and long pulse on the same input? I would like different actions to be triggered depending on how long the input remains active. Kind regards, [user_name].
Hi, Yes, this can be done. You would use two on-delay timers with distinct settings.
Hi, [user_name]. For your requirement, you will find the necessary functions under 'Special Functions' in [product_name] [product_name].

Here's an example that may assist you. You need to block the input signal while the pushbutton remains pressed so you can measure whether it was held for 1 or 2 seconds.
